description: A shell script that manages versioning for a software agent, including functions for retrieving, incrementing, setting, and displaying version information, and ensuring dependencies like jq are installed.

methods.name: print_error
methods.description: Outputs an error message in red color to standard error.

methods.name: print_success
methods.description: Outputs a success message in green color to standard output.

methods.name: print_info
methods.description: Outputs an informational message in blue color.

methods.name: print_warning
methods.description: Outputs a warning message in yellow color.

methods.name: check_jq
methods.description: Checks if jq is available in the system; exits if not present.

methods.name: init_version_file
methods.description: Initializes the version file with default version info if it does not exist.

methods.name: get_current_version
methods.description: Retrieves the current version string from the version file.

methods.name: get_current_version_tag
methods.description: Retrieves the current version string prefixed with 'v'.

methods.name: get_next_version
methods.description: Calculates the next alpha version by incrementing the alpha build number.

methods.name: get_next_version_tag
methods.description: Retrieves the next alpha version tag with 'v' prefix.

methods.name: increment_version
methods.description: Increments the alpha build number, updates version metadata including git commit, timestamp, and writes back to the version file.

methods.name: set_version
methods.description: Sets a specific version provided by the user, updating the version file accordingly.

methods.name: show_version_info
methods.description: Displays current version, next version, last release timestamp, git commit, and path to version file.
